answer: 按钮的最小尺寸是 24 × 24 CSS 像素，这是 2.5.8 目标尺寸（最小）的要求，级别为 AA。达不到时，需要在目标周围留出足够的间距。

points.text: 指针操作的目标尺寸至少为 24 × 24 CSS 像素。
points.quote: The size of the target for pointer inputs is at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels
points.title: 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum)

points.text: 小于 24 × 24 像素的目标，若以其边界框中心画直径 24 像素的圆，圆与其他目标或其他小目标的圆都不能相交，则可以符合要求。
points.quote: Undersized targets (those less than 24 by 24 CSS pixels) are positioned so that if a 24 CSS pixel diameter circle is centered on the bounding box of each, the circles do not intersect another target or the circle for another undersized target
points.title: 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum)

points.text: 如果按钮本身就是 24 × 24 像素，则不需要额外间距。
points.quote: Since the target size itself is 24 by 24 CSS pixels, no additional spacing is required, the success criterion passes.
points.title: 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum)
points.source_text:
Three buttons are on-screen and the target size of each button is 24 by 24 CSS pixels. Since the target size itself is 24 by 24 CSS pixels, no additional spacing is required, the success criterion passes.
A row of buttons, each of which has a horizontal width of more than 24 CSS pixels, a height of only 20 CSS pixels, and vertical margin of 4 CSS pixels above and below the row of buttons. Since there is sufficient spacing both above and below the row of buttons, the success criterion passes.
Links within a paragraph of text have varying target dimensions. Links within paragraphs of text do not need to meet the 24 by 24 CSS pixels requirements, so the success criterion passes.

points.text: 句子或段落中的文字链接不受此最小尺寸要求限制。
points.quote: Links within paragraphs of text do not need to meet the 24 by 24 CSS pixels requirements

citations.source_text:
Goal:
Make controls easier to activate.
What to do:
Ensure targets meet a minimum size or have sufficient spacing around them.
Why it's important:
Some people with physical impairments cannot click small buttons that are close together.
